brief.title: Generate deterministic 6-class seeded-defect mutant twins from clean candidate bundles
brief.plain_summary: Inject digest mismatch, boundary off-by-one, silent exception swallow, capability-tier violation, self-approval principal reuse and ungrounded citation span defects into clean candidate bundles.
brief.outcome: Deterministic twin calibration suite pairing clean candidate bundles with six targeted defect mutants each.

Never use public_commons or allowlist other surfaces. Return every produced noun's pin in output.artifacts; add its value when the requester asks for inline delivery.
